release_gate.reason: matching set is outside its declared age window
release_gate.limits: Ready means only that one explicit call exactly equals one member of a complete matching historical rehearsal set within the reviewer-declared age window. It is not approval, authorization, a signature, or permission to send. The caller may be a contract and need not be an available transaction origin. No current state, future inclusion, gas, fees, nonce, effects, ABI authenticity, authority, wallet, provider identity, or chain authenticity is established. Calls in the set are independent; no writes are simulated. Nothing is sent.

set_expiry.reason: complete matching set is older than the declared age window

set_binding.reason: every planned independent call matches at the exact reviewed block

binding.reason: explicit call, exact block and expected return bytes all match
binding.limits: Bound means only that this explicit call and expected bytes match saved provider evidence at the exact reviewed historical block. It is not approval to transact. The sender may be a contract: this does not prove that anyone can originate the call. No nonce, gas, fees, access list, wallet wrapping, signatures, state effects, ABI meaning, balances, current state or future success are checked. Even a returned ABI false may be bound if those exact bytes were expected. Digests identify input content; they do not authenticate a provider or the chain. Nothing is sent.

set_binding.limits: Bound means complete matching historical provider evidence for independent calls at one exact block. Calls do not share simulated writes: this is not a sequence, multicall, atomic transaction, or state-effect simulation. Order has no execution meaning. Expected bytes are supplied by the reviewer; an expected ABI false can match. No ABI authentication, gas, fees, nonce, authority, current state or future success is established. Digests identify content, not authenticity. Nothing is sent.

set_expiry.limits: Fresh means only complete matching historical provider evidence inside the reviewer-declared age window. The review time is an input, not an independently verified clock. The window is a review policy, not a guarantee against state changes. No current state, future execution, gas, authority, ABI authenticity, provider identity or chain authenticity is established. Calls are independent and do not share simulated writes. No network request or transaction is made.

limits: Ready is a historical evidence handoff, never permission to transact. The sender can be a contract and need not be an available transaction origin. Review time, age policy, signature and return layout are reviewer inputs. Supplied headers are not consensus-authenticated; call returns are RPC claims, not proved state effects. Selector matching does not authenticate an ABI or establish reachability. No current state, authorization, gas, nonce, fees, atomic sequence or future execution is established. Nothing is sent.
